title: Broiler.Documents set-aside families for the LibreOffice sw/qa/extras ranking
description: The families of upstream samples that are fuzzer output rather than documents. The extras runner sets them aside: it does not compare them with LibreOffice and does not rank them, and it still requires broilerdoc to handle each one with a documented exit code. A family is a claim about where a file came from, so it carries the evidence for that claim and the files it is known to match.

policy.description: Why the file exists, in prose, next to the rows it governs.

scope.description: Where the line is: fuzzer output is set aside, a real document that once crashed LibreOffice is not.

stillRanked.description: Samples that look like they might belong to a family and must not: no pattern may match one. Each is a path relative to sw/qa/extras.

pattern.description: A .NET regular expression, matched case-insensitively against the sample's file name - not its path.

evidence.description: The upstream test that asserts only that LibreOffice survives the file, and what in the file shows it was generated.

examples.description: Every file the family is known to match, as a path relative to sw/qa/extras.
